info.title: CMMS API compatibility catalog
info.description: Generated from the existing Express route graph. Existing paths, methods, payloads, status codes, and response fields remain immutable.

503.description: A required dependency is not ready

401.description: Metrics bearer credential is missing or invalid

x-cmms-compatibility.note: The declaration catalog preserves legacy route expressions while request and response schemas are added incrementally without normalizing existing contracts.

processorTokenBootstrap.note: The existing route and response are preserved; a processor-only credential is required before a token can be minted.
